text:
maya: Quick thread — I want to align on the autoscale/ramp + burst accounting plan for Dedicated before the roadmap sync. Customer asks stacking up, need clear launch criteria.
seb: cool, what's the top-level decision we need?
maya: three things: 1) ramp window (how fast do we scale up), 2) how burst consumption decreases reserved credit (billing model), 3) safe defaults for new tenants.
rachel: customers care most about predictable SLOs. for a few enterprise accounts burst is fine, but they want clear visibility and hard caps.
anil: technical constraints: GPU pool spin-up ~90–180s for cold nodes unless we pre-warm. so ramp_window <-> cold start tradeoff.
seb: can we do a two-tier ramp? immediate soft-increase from cache/prefetch, then hard scaling of nodes. i.e. fast token-level batching + slower node attach.
maya: that's what i was thinking. propose: ramp_window: 2m fast path (KV/prefix cache + instance reuse), 10m full node attach. start small, expand.
olga: pricing question — how do we show burst costs to customers? they want to avoid surprise bills.
maya: two options: (A) bill burst against reserved pool credit (cheaper than on-demand but consumes quota), (B) bill burst as overage at premium rate.
rachel: customers prefer quota consumption over surprise invoices. they'd rather see quota drop and hit alerts.
anil: implementation note: quota ledger already exists per-tenant. adding "burst_budget" counter is easy. downside: complexity in UI + edge cases during rollouts.
seb: if we go quota-consumption, need a timeout/decay so short spikes don't permanently reduce quota. e.g., burst_budget decays 1%/min back to baseline.
maya: agreed. propose decay window of 24h for full replenishment, with configurable fast-recovery for test tenants.
seb: example config prototype:
```yaml
autoscale:
  target_qps: 500
  fast_ramp_seconds: 120
  full_ramp_seconds: 600
  burst_budget_tokens: 1000
  burst_decay_hours: 24
  billing_mode: quota-consume
```
maya: launch criteria (suggested):
- infra: fast_ramp implemented + KV cache metrics in prod
- infra: ledger + decay logic + UI showing burst_consumed metric
- product: default policy for new tenants + opt-in toggle for billed-overage
- reliability: SLO tests for 95th latency under mixed workload
- docs: clear pricing doc + alerts templates
seb: add: canary with 10 tenants, 2 regions for 48h with simulated flash traffic. roll back if queueing >10s or node attach error rate >1%.
rachel: CS will prepare comms and a migration plan for existing reserved customers (how burst interacts with current commit).
olga: sales needs a short FAQ: "how is burst billed? how to set hard caps? how to get more reserved capacity?". we can reuse parts of docs.
maya: open questions: 1) hard cap override for security incidents? 2) per-route vs per-tenant quotas?
anil: per-route is more complex but useful for multi-tenant apps. maybe start per-tenant, add per-route later.
seb: security incidents: we should support immediate hard cap via control-plane toggle (manual) + automated circuit breaker if anomaly detection flags abuse.
maya: ok — next steps: seb/anil to draft RFC with config API + pseudocode for ledger decay and canary plan by EOW. rachel/olga will collect top 5 customers to invite to preview. i'll update the roadmap ticket and include launch criteria.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: draft-rfc/autoscale-burst v0.1 -> review (maya) at 1763380000
seb: 👍 will start prototyping the ledger and fast path.
anil: i'll map infra impacts and estimate effort (ETA 2 wks for MVP).
maya: thanks — short sync Thurs 10am to finalize defaults. :thumbsup:
